account: The Changjiang Water Resources Commission's Hydrology Bureau released a hydrology model named Jiupai on 6 December 2024 at a basin hydrology meeting in Yunnan. China Water Resources News reported that the bureau had developed the model itself and that the model and its platform were still in a founding stage. On 13 December 2024, ZTE described itself as a key technical support unit that released the model jointly with the bureau. In its later ITU account, ZTE describes an operational hydrology model with the Changjiang Hydrological Bureau as a partner. It reports shorter report writing, faster thalweg drawing, and prediction and query accuracy figures. The system is intended to support water management and flood planning. Specific flood interventions and prevented losses remain undocumented.
